name: Abler
tagline: Training schedules, event sign-ups and messages in Abler
description: Check your family’s training sessions and events in Abler, see who’s signed up and read messages from coaches. You can also respond to events and send messages if you enable changes.
examples: When is the next football practice?
Who's signed up for Saturday's match?
Show me the latest messages from the coach.
auth: phone or email + SMS code (browser-assisted login; needs Node.js and Chrome/Chromium)
requires: Bun 1.1+, plus Node.js and Chrome/Chromium for the one-time login

tools.name: abler_doctor
tools.description: Check the saved session and API access

tools.name: abler_events
tools.description: Calendar events by month, week or cursor

tools.name: abler_operations
tools.description: Paginated catalog of recovered API operations

tools.name: abler_operation
tools.description: One operation's variables and GraphQL document

tools.name: abler_watch
tools.description: Observe a real-time subscription for a bounded interval

tools.name: abler_mutate
tools.description: Execute a catalog mutation; dry-run unless confirm is true

envVars.name: ABLER_NODE
envVars.description: Node.js executable for the login helper (default node)

envVars.name: ABLER_SOURCE_DIR
envVars.description: Package/checkout directory if the CLI cannot locate it

envVars.name: ABLER_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to register the MCP write tool

is.tagline: Æfingar, viðburðir og skilaboð í Abler
is.description: Skoðaðu æfingatíma og viðburði fjölskyldunnar í Abler, hverjir eru skráðir og skilaboð frá þjálfurum. Einnig er hægt að skrá mætingu og senda skilaboð ef þú leyfir breytingar.
examples: Hverjir eru skráðir á leikinn á laugardaginn?
Sýndu mér nýjustu skilaboðin frá þjálfaranum.
is.requires: Bun 1.1 eða nýrra, auk Node.js og Chrome eða Chromium fyrir fyrstu innskráningu
